recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, low-angle group portrait of six men in rugged attire standing in a V-formation within a decaying industrial doorway, featuring heavy backlighting, atmospheric smoke, and high-contrast textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure as the apex of a symmetrical V-formation
Backlit atmospheric haze contrasting with dark foreground silhouettes
Rough asphalt texture mirrored by distressed serif typography
Industrial architectural framing containing the subjects
coreInvariants: Desaturated color palette with teal/orange undertones
Distressed, weathered textures on all surfaces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six subjects arranged in a receding V-shape; the lead figure is central and largest in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and torso, framed by the bright light of the doorway.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central figure, move outward along the diagonal lines of the band members, then drop to the large-scale typography at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy shadows in the bottom corners and bright, hazy light in the upper center doorway.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated charcoal and slate grays for clothing and environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool teal-white for the atmospheric backlight and smoke.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm, earthy browns and ochres in the rusted door frames and skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the bright background and dark foreground.

letterConstructionRules: Wide proportions for the primary title
Heavy distressing and texture overlay within the glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal rules extending from the sides of the secondary text line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scales of the same serif family separated by horizontal rules.

candidateDirections.reason: Classical proportions and sharp serifs match the base skeleton.
Offers the wide, sturdy presence required for the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of men in rugged clothing standing in a V-formation inside a large, decaying industrial doorway. High contrast, backlit with smoke, low angle, gritty textures, desaturated colors.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered uppercase serif text at the bottom. The top line is smaller, flanked by horizontal lines. The bottom line is significantly larger. Apply a heavy grit/erosion texture to the text.

verificationChecks: Is the texture on the letters consistent with the ground?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals

mustAchieve: Sense of depth through atmospheric perspective
Unified gritty texture across image and type

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic shadow casting from the subjects toward the viewer.
Ensure the smoke doesn't obscure the central figure's silhouette.
Verify the horizontal rules are perfectly level.
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Setting + V-Formation Group + Backlit Smoke + Distressed Serif Type = Gritty Band Aesthetic
